title: SonicWall security advisory (AV26-1048)
description: As of October 14, 2026, SonicWall is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product:
products:
Network Security Manager (NSM) On-Prem (VMWare, Hyper-V, Azure and KVM)
	Version 4.3.1 and prior
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
